description: This is a PHP unit test class for the ViewDetail class in the SuiteCRM application, testing its constructor, preDisplay, and display methods, and verifying object instantiation and HTML output.

classes.name: ViewDetailTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ViewDetail class functionality in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testViewDetail
methods.description: Tests that the ViewDetail object is instantiated correctly and its type attribute is set to 'detail'.

methods.name: testpreDisplay
methods.description: Tests the preDisplay method initializing the detail view object (dv) for modules 'Users' and 'Meetings' and verifies its type and definitions array.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Tests the display method of the ViewDetail class to ensure it outputs HTML content when invoked.
